decisions.reason: Designs paste_image/paste_file with (2),(3) numbered before the extension, picking the smallest unused n, reserving names already assigned in the same batch and across live attachments, and applies renaming only in the paste acquisition path before record creation while drop and picker keep real names; grounded in the add() excerpt where label is item.path and in validateItems' batch-only duplicate check.

Names the live composer snapshot occurrences as the authoritative taken-name source and correctly explains that the alive-subscription in add() deletes the records entry on any momentary empty snapshot while the attachment is still live, so the cache cannot be trusted; in-batch reservations are added to the set and records only supplement.

Grounds the stale label in the captured response (x-cache HIT, age 178, cached page maxing out at v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip(tag), and gives the semantic rule: show an update chip only when the remote tag is newer than the running PLUGIN_VERSION, otherwise show the running version, never the older fetched tag.

Proposes concrete tests with expected names for repeated and same-batch pastes, a live occurrence still blocking a name after records eviction, unchanged drop/picker names, plus chip tests for a stale older tag against 0.2.10 and a genuinely newer tag, with concrete assertions.

Requires syncing package.json version with the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in the shipped lib bundle, a node --check syntax check plus the behavioral regressions, and explains that with no host-side update endpoint users get the artifact by installing a newer package version followed by a host restart/hard refresh, the chip only informing.
